description: IC02 bounded SVG profile. Each rejected file lists every problem it must produce, in order, located by marker text in that file (the marker's first character, or its n-th occurrence). valid.svg exercises every allowed element and attribute kind and must be accepted with its viewBox size.

expect.message: The SVG has a DOCTYPE; document type and entity declarations are not allowed.
The SVG is not well-formed XML: undefined entity.
expect.fix: Fix the XML, or export the SVG again.

cases.note: saxes reads no internal subset, so the entity it declares stays undefined and is reported where it is used

expect.message: The SVG is not well-formed XML: undefined entity.
expect.fix: Fix the XML, or export the SVG again.

cases.note: only the five XML entities and character references exist without a DTD

expect.message: Scripts are not allowed in an SVG.
expect.fix: Remove it, or export the SVG again with only the shapes, text and gradients it needs.

cases.note: the refused element is reported once; its content is not reported again

expect.message: The viewBox value "0 0 100 50" must be four numbers: min-x, min-y, width and height.
The preserveAspectRatio value "xMidYMid slice" must be none, or xMinYMin to xMaxYMax, optionally followed by meet or slice.
The x1 value "1 " must be a finite length, such as 12, 12px or 50%.
The width value " 10" must be a finite length, such as 12, 12px or 50%.
The opacity value "0.5 " must be a finite number or a percentage.
The points value "0 0  10 10" must list numbers.
The x value "1 2" must list lengths.
The d value "M0 0 L10 10" has a M command without its 2 numbers.
The transform value "translate(1 2)" has an invalid translate().
The transform value "translate(1 2) scale(2)" must be a list of matrix(), translate(), scale(), rotate(), skewX() and skewY().
The stroke-dasharray value "1 2" must list non-negative lengths.
The stroke-linecap value "round " must be one of butt, round, square.
The font-family value " Inter" must be a list of font names, with no brackets, colons, slashes or other punctuation.

cases.note: SVG's wsp and CSS whitespace are space, tab, line feed and carriage return (and form feed, which XML 1.0 cannot hold); U+00A0 NO-BREAK SPACE is part of the value in every number, list, path, transform, viewBox and keyword grammar, as a browser reads it, so each value that holds one is refused (W5R-22)

expect.message: The fill reference url(#missing) names no element in this file.
expect.fix: Point it at the id of an element in this file, or remove it.

expect.message: The fill reference url(#c) names a clipPath, not a linearGradient or radialGradient.
expect.fix: Point it at an element of the right kind.

expect.message: Text in the text element contains url( or @import, which the profile does not allow.
expect.fix: Rewrite the text without url( or @import.

Embedded or linked images are not allowed in an SVG; use a raster image block instead.
expect.fix: Remove it, or export the SVG again with only the shapes, text and gradients it needs.

expect.fix: Remove it, or export the SVG again with only the shapes, text and gradients it needs.

expect.fix: Add xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" to the root svg element.

expect.fix: Remove it, or export the SVG again with only the shapes, text and gradients it needs.

expect.message: The viewBox value "0 0 0 50" must have a width and height greater than 0.

The height value "1e999" must be a finite length, such as 12, 12px or 50%.
The SVG declares the ISO-8859-1 encoding; only UTF-8 is accepted.
expect.fix: Save the file as UTF-8 and declare encoding="UTF-8", or leave the encoding out.

expect.message: The SVG declares XML version 1.1; only version 1.0 is accepted.
expect.fix: Declare version="1.0", or leave the XML declaration out.

cases.note: saxes reads a file declared as anything but 1.0 with XML 1.1's character rules

expect.message: The SVG declares XML version 1.1; only version 1.0 is accepted.
